areaName: Downtown Grand Rapids — Bridge St / Near Westside & Cherry St / Heritage Hill / East Hills
locationNotes: Focus on duplexes, townhomes, upper/lower flats, and houses in two walkable urban zones: (1) Bridge Street NW & near Westside just west of the Grand River (49504, generally east of Covell Ave / not too far west), and (2) Cherry Street SE, Heritage Hill, East Hills, and Eastown (49503 / 49506). Exclude large apartment complexes.
